sourceProducts.title: 2026 All-Star Game Set - MLB Topps NOW® - 19 Card Set - PR: 16306
lines: 2026 All-Star Game Set - MLB Topps NOW® - 19 Card Set - PR: 16306
(1) Numbered Parallel, Unnumbered Parallel, or Autograph per set
19-card complete set - featuring 18 of the top All-Star Game selections from both the American and National League teams, PLUS (1) of the following cards guaranteed:
Sequentially numbered base card parallel to /99 or lower
Redemption for autographed base card parallel /10 or lower
Foil-Numbered Parallel Card numbered to /99 or lower:

Voted in by the fans and here now for your collection, it’s the official 2026 Topps NOW MLB All-Star Game set! Included in this 19-card set are the 2026 MLB All-Star Game selections, featuring 18 of the top overall selections to both the American and National League teams, PLUS one of the following cards guaranteed: Sequentially numbered base card parallel to /99 or lower, unnumbered All-Star Game LogoFractor, or redemption for an autographed base card parallel to /10 or less!
sourceProducts.qualification: Normalized factual text from the fresh official product UI; not a raw HTML hash. Bundle PR16306 and 19-card configuration do not assign a print run to every PDF entry. Exact six-color numbering applies only to base parallels; the separate autograph upper bound does not name a color ladder.
